_comment: TOOL is public code, documentation and measurements of the tool itself.
FIXTURE is synthetic test input reproduced by tools/make_fixtures.py.
DATA is real runtime output, versioned in a separate PRIVATE companion.
Credentials remain outside version control under the companion's Mode B policy.
Real DATA is physically absent from this public source tree, including ignored paths.
_audited: Runtime Config proves the selected Git companion PRIVATE before reading product data or resolving writes. Metrics, compliance and per-run destinations are canonicalized and confined to that selection. Explicit/environment selections cannot fall through to another product. Public-tree DATA patterns remain declared even though runtime writes occur in the companion. Promotion4 separately verifies every effective remote fetch/push destination and rejects existing hardlinked runtime files. Listed synthetic tests and sample_events are reproduced by tools/make_fixtures.py.
_data_home: The authoritative Config root, selected explicitly or with PROMO_CONFIG_DIR and its documented aliases. Config requires a separate versioned PRIVATE GitHub companion; no source-tree or unversioned fallback is allowed.
